title: nbn Enterprise Ethernet Services issue – Cheltenham (VIC) POI
current_summary: The issue affecting nbn Enterprise Ethernet Services connected through the Cheltenham (Victoria) point of interconnect has been resolved. All affected services were restored at around 8:09pm AEDT on 9 November 2026. The fault was caused by a software issue inside nbn's network, and work is continuing to help prevent it from happening again.

cause.detailed: A code fault between nbn's Enterprise Ethernet portal and its API stopped network adjustments from completing, which took services offline.

updates.content: We are aware of an issue affecting nbn Enterprise Ethernet Services connected through the Cheltenham (Victoria) point of interconnect. The issue was first reported at around 6:24am AEDT on 9 November 2026, following routine changes. Our team is investigating. We don't yet know the full extent of the impact or when services will be restored, and we will provide another update as soon as we know more.

As of 9:39am AEDT on 9 November 2026, the issue affecting nbn Enterprise Ethernet Services through the Cheltenham (Victoria) point of interconnect has been escalated within nbn. We are waiting on an estimated restoration time and will update you once we have one.

As of 4:22pm AEDT on 9 November 2026, nbn has identified the cause of the issue affecting Enterprise Ethernet Services through the Cheltenham (Victoria) point of interconnect as a software (API) fault inside its network. nbn is still working to resolve it and expects this to happen overnight, though no confirmed restoration time has been provided. We will update you as soon as we have more information.

As of 8:09pm AEDT on 9 November 2026, all nbn Enterprise Ethernet Services connected through the Cheltenham (Victoria) point of interconnect have been restored and the issue is resolved. The cause was a software fault between nbn's Enterprise Ethernet portal and its API, which stopped network adjustments from completing and took services offline. Work is continuing with nbn to help prevent this from happening again. If you are still experiencing problems with your service, please contact our support team.
